projects.name: Hexworth C2 Device Firmware
projects.shortDescription: Hexworth's reference C2-backed device. WiFi captive-portal provisioning, optional pairing-code registration, command-and-control loop with ping/echo/blink/reboot capabilities.

projects.name: WiFiManager Captive-Portal Template
projects.shortDescription: Bare provisioning skeleton: WiFi captive portal, NVS-backed credentials, factory-reset gesture. Starting point for any new provisioned IoT device. No backend wiring.

projects.name: MicroPython for Raspberry Pi Pico
projects.shortDescription: Official MicroPython firmware (v1.23). Drag-drop install via the Pico's BOOTSEL USB-mass-storage mode — no browser flashing required. Once installed, write Python directly on the Pico using Thonny.

projects.name: Hexworth Blink (Arduino Mega 2560)
projects.shortDescription: First sketch for the Arduino Mega. Blinks the on-board LED at 1 Hz. Primary path is Arduino IDE (offline, reliable); secondary path is Arduino Web Editor (cloud, requires free account).

projects.name: Raspberry Pi OS (Pi 3 / 4 / 5)
projects.shortDescription: Full Linux OS install on SD card or USB drive. Use Raspberry Pi Imager — the official tool — to write the image. Walks through hostname, SSH, and WiFi pre-config so first boot is headless-friendly.
